title: About Knightlight Books
intro: An independent publishing house, built around one idea: stories worth getting lost in.
body:
Knightlight Books is an independent UK publishing house founded by author Hallam Knight. We publish across five imprints, each with its own voice and its own readers:

- **Knightlight Fiction**: character-driven novels, from modern Western sagas to courtroom mysteries and romance.
- **Knightlight Sci-Fi**: big-canvas science fiction, starting with *The Long Dark Between*.
- **Knightlight Fantasy**: new worlds in the making.
- **Knightlight Manga**: illustrated adventures for readers aged 10–16.
- **Knightlight Kids**: warm, funny picture books for ages 3–5.

## Why buy direct?

When you buy an ePub here, more of the price goes straight to the people who make the books. You get a file you can read on almost any device, delivered instantly.

## Where else to find us

Our books are also available from Kobo, Google Play Books and, for some titles, Amazon. Follow along on Instagram or join the reading list to hear about new releases first.
